story: Teenager Marty McFly gets zapped back to 1955 in a time machine Doc Brown built out of a DeLorean sports car. By accident, Marty stops his own parents from falling in love. Now he has to get them back together and race to the clock tower for his one shot at getting home.
trivia: The DeLorean needs to hit exactly 88 mph, powered by 1.21 gigawatts, to break the time barrier.
Michael J. Fox filmed his TV show all day and this movie all night. He barely slept for months!
Another actor, Eric Stoltz, filmed Marty for weeks before Michael J. Fox took over the part.
Doc's dog in 1955 is Copernicus and in 1985 is Einstein: both named after famous scientists.
quote: Your future is whatever you make it. So make it a good one.
numbers: the speed the DeLorean must hit to travel through time

scenes: Doc's very first test: he sends his dog Einstein one minute into the future.
The yellow radiation suit. Marty wears it again later, as Darth Vader from the planet Vulcan.
Look on the roof: Mr. Fusion, the machine that runs on garbage in the very last scene.
questions: Marty's family photo keeps fading as the movie goes on. What does that photo really show, and why does it come back at the end?
What if Marty had never pushed George out of the way of the car? Trace what happens next.
Doc says nobody should know too much about their own future. Would you want to know yours? Why or why not?
catchphrase: Where we're going, we don't need roads.
